descriptionEn: Offered for sale: an apartment located on Rruga Muharrem Fejza, near Lagjja e Kaltër, in Prishtina.
The property has an area of 70.58m² of living space and a 56.29m² terrace, offering a very good combination of indoor and outdoor space.
The apartment is located on the 1st floor, in a building with an elevator, and faces West.
The space consists of a living room with kitchen, two bedrooms and one bathroom. The apartment is fully furnished and ready to move in.
The property has an ownership certificate and the sale contract is signed at the notary.
The price of the property is €140,000, negotiable.
